summary: Frontend-only regression tested at 375x667. The app loads without runtime errors, but the rules modal close control remains below the viewport and cannot be dismissed through the requested UI flow.

ui_bugs.issue: After opening the rules modal at 375x667, close-rules has bounding box x=301, y=798.05, width=44, height=44, placing it below the 667px viewport. The dismissal assertion fails.

action_items: Rework rules bottom-sheet/header layout so close-rules is positioned within the visible 375x667 sheet, then rerun the mobile regression.
critical_code_review_comments: The attempted absolute positioning on close-rules does not resolve the rendered web position; inspect sheet/header sizing and Modal layout rather than only the icon position.
context_for_next_testing_agent: At the public Expo preview, app loaded at 375x667 and no console errors matching ERROR/Error/TypeError/ReferenceError were found. Opening rules-button reproduced the offscreen close-rules control; test stopped at the required dismissal assertion.
rca_of_issue: The close icon's rendered web bounding box is y=798 despite the 667px viewport and the IconButton's absolute top/right styles. This indicates the containing sheet/header is laid out below the visible modal region or is affected by React Native web Modal layout; positioning the icon alone is insufficient. Reproduce with rules-button at 375x667, inspect close-rules bounding box, then fix the sheet/header geometry.
